detail.longDescription: 📚️ 🇺🇸 🇦🇺 Exploring eugenics and race in North American and Australian introductory psychology textbooks "These findings highlight concerns about psychology education: most introductory textbooks – at least those used in the United States and Australia – have failed to acknowledge the role of psychology in eugenics, poorly defined race, and perhaps increase the risk of reinforcing harmful racial stereotypes." Umer, H., Brooker, J. and Butler, D. (2026) ‘Exploring eugenics and race in North American and Australian introductory psychology textbooks’, Evolutionary Human Sciences, 8, p. e45. doi: https:// ww.doi.org/10.1017/ehs.2026.10 056 . # OpenAccess # OA # Academia # Research # Article # Book # Books # Race # Eugenics # Psychology # Science # Racism # Intelligence
